channel.title: IngestThis
channel.description: Articles, tutorials, and resources for Data Engineers, Scientists, Analysts, and Architects.

item.title: Agent-Driven Storage Tiering for Apache Iceberg: Moving Cold Data Without Breaking Queries
item.description: A background agent can move cold Iceberg partitions to cheaper tiers without breaking live queries. Heatmaps, path-safe moves, and restore paths.

item.title: Securing the Agentic Lakehouse Gateway: Preventing Prompt Injection and Data Exfiltration
item.description: Agentic lakehouse gateways face prompt injection and exfiltration through query results. A threat model and defenses for the layer in front of data.

item.title: Apache Ossie and Apache Polaris: Putting Semantic Models in the Open Catalog
item.description: Apache Ossie and Polaris put metric definitions in the open catalog. What the spec covers, what Polaris stores, and what is still unfinished.

item.title: Arrow Flight SQL and ADBC: Why the Database Driver Is the Slowest Part of Your Query
item.description: JDBC and ODBC often dominate large-result time. Flight SQL and ADBC keep data columnar from server to client, with Python, Go, and Rust examples.

item.title: DataFusion Comet 1.0 and What Native Rust Scans Change for Spark on Iceberg
item.description: DataFusion Comet 1.0 replaces Spark Iceberg scans with native Rust. What speeds up, what still falls back to the JVM, and how to deploy it.

item.title: FSST and ALP: The Two Encodings Fixing Parquet's Weakest Compression Cases
item.description: ALP and FSST target Parquet's worst cases: floats and high-cardinality strings. How they work and what they change for Iceberg tables.

item.title: Governance-as-Code for the Lakehouse: Managing REST Catalog RBAC and Masking in Git
item.description: Put REST catalog RBAC and masking in Git. How to review grants, apply them safely, and keep lakehouse access from drifting.

item.title: Metric Contracts in Code: Testing, Versioning, and Serving Business Logic to Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: Metric contracts in code let teams test, version, and serve business logic to multi-agent systems without each agent inventing its own SQL.

item.title: High-Throughput Branch Merging: Automating Concurrency and Conflict Resolution in Multi-Branch Iceberg Pipelines
item.description: High-throughput Iceberg branch merges need conflict detection and automation. How to reconcile concurrent writes without stalling pipelines.

item.title: Multi-Cloud REST Catalog Topologies: Running Apache Polaris Across AWS, Azure, and GCP
item.description: Polaris can catalog Iceberg tables across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Four topologies, credential vending, and the tradeoffs of each design.

item.title: Parquet-Only Manifests in Iceberg v4: Why the Metadata Layer Is Going Columnar
item.description: Iceberg v4 is moving manifests from Avro to Parquet so planners can read only the stats they need. Why the metadata layer is going columnar.

item.title: Query Routing at Machine Scale: Dynamic Workload Distribution Across Lakehouse Engines
item.description: Route each lakehouse query by shape, not by sender. Signals, rules, and how to keep dashboards, batch jobs, and agents from sharing one engine.

item.title: Semantic Layer Federation: One Logical Model Over Data on Three Clouds
item.description: One logical model over Iceberg and databases on three clouds. Pushdown, egress, Reflections, and where semantic federation still breaks.

item.title: Serverless Iceberg Ingestion with PyIceberg and DuckDB: Micro-Batches Without a Spark Cluster
item.description: Land small Iceberg micro-batches with PyIceberg and DuckDB in a serverless function. Commits, concurrency, and why Spark is the wrong default.

item.title: Zero-Copy Warehouse Modernization: Migrating Legacy Databases to Apache Iceberg Without Downtime
item.description: Move a legacy warehouse to Iceberg without downtime by virtualizing first. Consumer cutover, parity checks, and background copy without double-ETL.

item.title: The Agent Is Now a Named Coworker, and It Needs a File Format
item.description: Named, persistent agents need a file format. Open Agent Profile, Buzz, Grok Bot, and Hermes Bot Mode show why a portable agent identity matters.

item.title: Your Agent Should Answer the Phone: A Field Guide to AI Gateways on Slack, Discord, Telegram, Signal, and Teams
item.description: A field guide to AI gateways on Slack, Discord, Telegram, Signal, and Teams: architecture, auth, cost, and the failure modes that matter.

item.title: Graphs in AI Engineering Have Solved Three Problems. The Fourth Is the Plan.
item.description: Knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, and LangGraph solved three problems. The fourth is the work itself: a reviewable graph of bounded agentic loops.

item.title: The Hidden Cost of Tiny Iceberg Commits
item.description: Trace what one tiny Iceberg commit writes, then model hourly, per-minute, and per-second cadences so streaming costs become arithmetic, not adjectives.

item.title: Deletion Vectors vs Position Deletes vs Equality Deletes: The Iceberg Delete Story in 2026
item.description: Position deletes, equality deletes, and deletion vectors compared from the Iceberg spec: what each writes, how readers apply it, and when to use which.
